The Petitioner has claimed reimbursement of the fee paid by it for filing the Petition and publication expenses. The Petitioner has further submitted that it is entitled to recover the reimbursement of the filing fee and the expenses incurred on publication of notices in the application for tariff approval, directly from the beneficiaries or the longterm customers, as the case may be, in accordance with Regulation 94(1) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. 81. The Petitioner filed its rejoinder vide affidavit dated 18.7.2025, submitted that reimbursement of the Petition filing fee and publication expenses is permissible under Regulations 91(1) and 94(4) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations and has been consistently allowed by the Commission in previous orders. It is, therefore, prayed that such recovery from the beneficiaries on a pro-rata basis may be allowed in the present case as well 82. We have considered the Petitioner and Respondent’s submissions. In previous orders, the Commission has taken a consistent view to reimburse the expenses on publication of notices as such expenses are incurred to meet the statutory requirement of transparency in the process of determining the tariff. Accordingly, the Petitioner is entitled to recover the fee paid for filing the Petition and the expenses for the publication incurred directly from the beneficiaries or long-term customers, as the case may be. - a) The details of AFC claimed by the Petitioner in the instant Petition, and the truedup AFC approved in the instant order with respect to the Combined Asset are as follows:
